documents.description: The documents to review, file names under the run's documents.

as_of.description: The review date (YYYY-MM-DD): a filing date after it is in the future.

doc_type.description: What kind of document is shown in <page_1>?

criteria.certificate_of_incorporation: A certificate or articles of incorporation (or formation) filed with a US state's filing office.
criteria.ein_letter: An IRS notice assigning an Employer Identification Number (CP 575 or similar).
criteria.bank_letter: A bank's letter confirming a business account (account verification or reference letter).
criteria.other: Any other document, or a page that cannot be read.

looks_altered.description: Does <page_1> show signs that someone edited the document after it was issued: a field covered over or pasted on, a date typed over another, a box with a visible edge or shadow, or a value misaligned or in a different typeface from the text around it?

issuer_marks.description: Does <page_1> carry the issuer's marks for a document of its kind: for a certificate or articles of incorporation, the filing office's seal or certification stamp; for a bank letter, the bank's letterhead; for an IRS EIN notice (CP 575), the IRS header and the notice number?

signed.description: Is every signature line in <page_1> signed with a handwritten or script signature? A document with no signature lines, such as an IRS EIN notice (CP 575), counts as yes.

name_consistent.description: Is the company's name legible, and is it the same name (same words, same suffix such as Inc., LLC or Corp.) everywhere it appears in <page_1>: heading, body and certification?

date_not_future.description: Is every filing, notice or execution date shown in <page_1> on or before the date in `as_of`?

steps.label: apply_thresholds

body.label: second_look
body.instructions: A first pass could not settle the checks in `unclear_checks`. Looking at <page_1> again with those in mind: is this document genuine, complete and unaltered, so that it can be accepted as issued, as of `as_of`?

valid.criteria: Genuine, complete and unaltered: nothing on the page contradicts that it was issued as shown.

doubtful.criteria: Something on the page is wrong, missing or cannot be confirmed from the image.

steps.label: record
steps.code:
(s) => ({ document: s.item, doc_type: s.checks.doc_type, verdict: s.verdict.status, decided_by: s.verdict.by,
  reasons: s.verdict.status === "invalid" ? s.triage.failed : s.verdict.status === "review" ? s.triage.unsure : [],
  probabilities: s.triage.p,
  second_look: s.second_look ? { taken: s.second_look.taken, unsure: s.second_look.unsure } : null })

steps.label: tally
steps.code:
(s) => { const rows = s.reviews.filter((r) => r); const n = (v) => rows.filter((r) => r.verdict === v).length;
  return { total: s.documents.length, valid: n("valid"), invalid: n("invalid"), review: n("review"), unreadable: (s.unreadable || []).length }; }

branches.label: template_report

steps.label: llm_prompt

args.system: You write document review reports for a KYB analyst. Plain, short, factual. Markdown.

steps.label: deliver
steps.code:
(s) => ({ tally: s.tally, reviews: s.reviews, unreadable: s.unreadable || [], report_template: s.report_template, report_llm: s.report_llm.text,
  report_llm_model: s.report_llm.model === undefined ? null : s.report_llm.model, report_llm_cost_usd: s.report_llm.cost_usd === undefined ? null : s.report_llm.cost_usd })
